name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After excelling in applied mathematics at university, he found himself drawn to the complexities of aerodynamics, initially working on industrial airflow simulations. A chance encounter with a local racing team led him to apply his expertise to motorsport, where he quickly proved his worth. His methodical approach to problem-solving, coupled with his strong management skills, saw him rapidly rise through the ranks.

As head of aero, Gareth is known for his ability to foster a collaborative environment, encouraging his team to explore innovative solutions while maintaining a laser focus on performance gains. He believes in the power of data-driven decision-making and is always looking for ways to optimize the car's aerodynamic package. His loyalty and dedication to the team are unwavering, making him a valuable asset to any organization.

Gareth's distinctive ability lies in translating complex aerodynamic concepts into practical, real-world improvements on the track. He is a master of extracting the maximum performance from every design, always seeking that extra tenth of a second that can make all the difference.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of medium build with a kind face and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn slide rule, even though he has access to advanced simulation software.
Has a habit of humming quietly while deep in thought, often variations on Welsh folk songs.
Insists on reviewing every wind tunnel test report personally, highlighting key data points with a red pen.
